```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
movies
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(audienceScore, tomatoMeter),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  movies_summary,
  aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative values indicate that audiences rated films higher than critics",
    x = "Mean Tomatometer Score - Audience Score",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  filter(gap > 0) |>
  distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(desc(gap)) |>
  slice_head(n = 8) |>
  select(title, audienceScore, tomatoMeter, gap)
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ") |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies_gap |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
